messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 3.5.2

3.5.2. Fire Depending on the hazards anticipated by the manufacturer, machinery must, where its size permits: — either allow easily accessible fire extinguishers to be fitted, or — be provided with built-in extinguisher systems.

response.text:
machinery | mustAllowFittingOf | easily accessible fire extinguishers | depending on hazards anticipated by the manufacturer and where its size permits | either allow easily accessible fire extinguishers to be fitted
machinery | mustBeProvidedWith | built-in extinguisher systems | depending on hazards anticipated by the manufacturer and where its size permits | or be provided with built-in extinguisher systems
